name: poptest
description: Testing harness for software that takes actions over time (AI agents, chatbots, workflows, APIs). Claude writes the fake world, fake tools, rules and 150-250 targeted multi-session cases from your spec; a deterministic stdlib CLI drives the real system, checks every action against the true state, replays and shrinks failures to short scripts, compares releases with a pre-declared rule, and measures how many planted faults the tests catch.
